description: 💡 Before multi-step work, check find_skill / list_workflows for canonical recipes. Create a website page as the website editor's "New → Page" does: a view from the default page template plus the page, with a URL made unique from the name. The page is created unpublished (publish with set_page_visibility). add_menu: also add it to the main menu. website_id: target website (default: the current one). Returns {page_id, view_id, url, menu_id?} — fill it with get_page_arch / set_page_arch.
name: create_page
